email.subject: MV IVELLE STAR - documents to new address
email.body:
Dear Operations,

Our document desk has moved. Please send the bills of lading, cargo manifest and the Master's ETA updates for MV IVELLE STAR to docs-desk@hanse-stee1.example from now on.

Best regards,
Chartering desk
Hanse Steel Chartering
